title: Correction
description: One record of an official correction, as a card, a print, or a words file appends it to its history. Referenced from oracle/card/normal.schema.json, print/print.json, print/card.schema.json, and print/set.schema.json.

path.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the corrected value, from the root of the record that holds this history. It names fields only and never steps into a list, so an array is corrected as a whole.

was.description: The value the path held immediately before this correction. Left out when the value did not exist before.

source.description: The official announcement of the correction, when one exists.

corrected_at.description: The date the value changed in this repository.
